author: nickyeow

english.text: This poem was originally written in French.

jyutping: ne1 sau2 si1 jyun4 bun2 hai6 jung6 faat3 man4 se2 ge3。
text: 呢首詩原本係用法文寫嘅。

author: nickyeow

english.text: You mustn't tell that to your parents.

jyutping: nei5 cin1 kei4 m4 hou2 gong2 ne1 gin6 si6 bei2 nei5 aa3 baa4 aa3 maa1 teng1。
text: 你千祈唔好講呢件事俾你阿爸阿媽聽。

author: nickyeow

english.text: His picture was in the newspaper.

jyutping: keoi5 fuk1 soeng2 soeng5 zo2 bou3 zi2。
text: 佢幅相上咗報紙。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I wish we had more time.

jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 dei6 jau5 do1 di1 si4 gaan1 mai6 hou2 lo1。
text: 如果我哋有多啲時間咪好囉。

author: tigro1973

english.text: Can I pay with a credit card?

jyutping: ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 jung6 seon3 jung6 kaat1 zaau2 sou3？
text: 可唔可以用信用卡找數？

author: nickyeow

english.text: You're no match for him.

jyutping: nei5 m4 gau3 keoi5 dau3 gaa3 laa3。
text: 你唔夠佢鬥㗎喇。

author: nickyeow

english.text: My sister made me a beautiful doll.

jyutping: ngo5 aa3 mui2 zing2 zo2 go3 hou2 leng3 ge3 gung1 zai2 bei2 ngo5。
text: 我阿妹整咗個好靚嘅公仔俾我。

author: nickyeow

english.text: The dress I like most is the black one.

jyutping: ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 go2 tiu4 kwan4 hai6 hak1 sik1 go2 tiu4。
text: 我最鍾意嗰條裙係黑色嗰條。

author: fercheung

english.text: Are you not tired?

jyutping: nei5 m4 gui6 aa3？
text: 你唔攰呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: I am angry that she didn't keep her promise.

jyutping: ngo5 niu5 keoi5 mou5 sau2 nok6 jin4。
text: 我嬲佢冇守諾言。

author: nickyeow

english.text: When I was younger I thought that ice cream vendors could eat as much ice cream as they wanted for free.

jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 ji5 wai4 syut3 gou1 dong3 go2 di1 siu2 faan2 ho2 ji5 min5 fai3 jam6 sik6 syut3 gou1。
text: 我細個嗰陣以為雪糕檔嗰啲小販可以免費任食雪糕。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Do y'all smoke?
Do you guys smoke?

jyutping: nei5 dei6 sik6 m4 sik6 jin1 gaa3？
text: 你哋食唔食煙㗎？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Tom goes to the supermarket almost every day.

jyutping: aa3 Tom caa1 m4 do1 mui5 jat6 dou1 wui5 heoi3 ciu1 kap1 si5 coeng4 maai5 je5。
text: 阿Tom差唔多每日都會去超級市場買嘢。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Don't be fooled again.

jyutping: m4 hou2 zoi3 bei2 jan4 ngaak1 laa3。
text: 唔好再俾人呃喇。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Don't get drunk.

jyutping: m4 hou2 jam2 zeoi3 aa1。
text: 唔好飲醉呀。

author: nickyeow

english.text: That guy is always asking his parents for money.

jyutping: tiu4 jau2 seng4 jat6 dou1 man6 lou5 dau6 lou5 mou2 lo2 cin2。
text: 條友成日都問老豆老母攞錢。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I had a good night's sleep.

jyutping: ngo5 fan3 dak1 hou2 lam1。
text: 我瞓得好冧。

author: WilliamKwok

english.text: I know that Tom has a girlfriend.
I know Tom has a girlfriend.

jyutping: ngo5 zi1 aa3 Tom jau5 neoi5 pang4 jau5。
text: 我知阿Tom有女朋友。

author: clowergen

english.text: Where's Australia?

jyutping: ou3 zau1 hai2 bin1 dou6 gaa3？
text: 澳洲喺邊度㗎？

author: clowergen

english.text: It is essentially a question of time.

jyutping: keoi5 gei1 bun2 soeng6 hai6 si4 gaan1 ge3 man6 tai4。
text: 佢基本上係時間嘅問題。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I love her more than anything in the world.

jyutping: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 ni1 go3 sai3 gaai3 soeng6 ge3 zeoi3 oi3。
text: 佢係我呢個世界上嘅最愛。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: Ziri had zero interest in Rima.

jyutping: zi1 lei6 deoi3 lei6 maa5 mat1 hing3 ceoi3 dou1 mou4。
text: 之利對利瑪乜興趣都無。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: I wish I could remember where I left my umbrella.

jyutping: ngo5 gei3 dak1 hai2 bin1 dou6 lau6 zo2 baa2 ze1 zau6 hou2 laak3。
text: 我記得喺邊度漏咗把遮就好嘞。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: Japan's climate is calm.

jyutping: jat6 bun2 hei3 hau6 wan1 wo4。
text: 日本氣候溫和。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Studying Latinate languages has been a stream of joy for me: I have learned at different levels the languages Spanish, Portuguese, French, Italian, Catalan, Chabacano (Chavacano), Elefen, Interlingua, Kreyòl, and Esperanto, but I have encountered them not in this order. In the Philippines, my native Tagalog from childhood has Spanish words embedded in it. I eventually took Spanish at university in BC. I had introductory French in Grade 5 on Lulu Island, continued it in high school, then in post-secondary education. I have learned the rest autodidactically. I have reading strength in my languages, but not much in speaking, except in Esperanto, in which I have attained a high level, partly due to my participation in various clubs. I enjoy reading novels in the different languages, especially in the genres of science fiction and fantasy, as I immerse myself in far-flung worlds. Romanian is for me still a vampiric curiosity, which I have not explored much. Additionally, I am curious also about Ladino, also known as Judeo-Spanish. Interestingly, I know how to pronounce Classical Latin.

jyutping: hok6 zaap6 laai1 ding1 jyu5 deoi3 ngo5 lai4 gong2 hai6 jat1 tiu4 hei2 jyut6：ngo5 hai2 m4 tung4 cang4 min6 hok6 gwo3 sai1 baan1 ngaa4 man4、pou4 tou4 ngaa4 man4、faat3 man4、ji3 daai6 lei6 man4、gaa1 taai3 lo4 nei4 aa3 man4、caa4 baa1 kaa1 nok6 man4（caa4 ngaa5 kaa1 nok6 man4）、oi1 loi4 fan1 man4、gwok3 zai3 jyu5 jin4、hak1 leoi4 ou3 ji5 man4 tung4 sai3 gaai3 jyu5，daan6 hai6 ngo5 jyu6 dou3 ge3 jyu5 jin4 m4 hai6 on3 ne1 go3 seon6 zeoi6。hai2 fei1 leot6 ban1，ngo5 sai3 go3 go2 si4 ge3 mou5 jyu5 taap3 gaa1 lok3 man4 jap6 min6 jau5 sai1 baan1 ngaa4 man4 ge3 ci4 jyu5。ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 hai2 bei1 si1 saang2 ge3 daai6 hok6 duk6 zo2 sai1 baan1 ngaa4 man4。ngo5 hai2 lou6 lou6 dou2 ng5 nin4 kap1 go2 zan6 jau5 jap6 mun4 faat3 man4，hai2 zung1 hok6 gai3 zuk6，zi1 hau6 hai2 zung1 hok6 hau6 ge3 gaau3 juk6。ngo5 ji5 ging1 zi6 hok6 hok6 zo2 kei4 jyu4 ge3 je5。ngo5 hai2 ngo5 ge3 jyu5 jin4 fong1 min6 jau5 jyut6 duk6 nang4 lik6，daan6 hai6 hai2 gong2 je5 fong1 min6 zau6 m4 do1，ceoi4 zo2 sai3 gaai3 jyu5，ngo5 hai2 sai3 gaai3 jyu5 fong1 min6 daat6 dou3 zo2 hou2 gou1 ge3 seoi2 ping4，bou6 fan6 jyun4 jan1 hai6 jan1 wai6 ngo5 caam1 gaa1 zo2 m4 tung4 ge3 keoi1 lok6 bou6。ngo5 zung1 ji3 tai2 m4 tung4 jyu5 jin4 ge3 siu2 syut3，dak6 bit6 hai6 fo1 waan6 siu2 syut3 tung4 kei4 waan6 siu2 syut3 ge3 leoi6 jing4，jan1 wai6 ngo5 wui6 cam4 zam3 hai2 jiu4 jyun5 ge3 sai3 gaai3 jap6 min6。lo4 maa5 nei4 aa3 man4 deoi3 ngo5 lai4 gong2 jing4 jin4 hai6 jat1 go3 kap1 hyut3 gwai2 ge3 hou2 kei4 sam1，ngo5 mou5 taam3 sok3 gwo3 taai3 do1。ling6 ngoi6，ngo5 deoi3 laai1 dik6 nok6 jik6 dou1 hou2 kei4，jau6 ming4 jau4 taai3 sai1 baan1 ngaa4 man4。jau5 ceoi3 ge3 hai6，ngo5 sik1 dak1 dim2 joeng2 faat3 jam1 gu2 din2 laai1 ding1 man4。
text: 學習拉丁語對我嚟講係一條喜悅：我喺唔同層面學過西班牙文、葡萄牙文、法文、意大利文、加泰羅尼亞文、查巴卡諾文（查瓦卡諾文）、埃萊芬文、國際語言、克雷奧爾文同世界語，但係我遇到嘅語言唔係按呢個順序。喺菲律賓，我細個嗰時嘅母語塔加洛文入面有西班牙文嘅詞語。我最終喺卑詩省嘅大學讀咗西班牙文。我喺露露島五年級嗰陣有入門法文，喺中學繼續，之後喺中學後嘅教育。我已經自學學咗其餘嘅嘢。我喺我嘅語言方面有閱讀能力，但係喺講嘢方面就唔多，除咗世界語，我喺世界語方面達到咗好高嘅水平，部分原因係因為我參加咗唔同嘅俱樂部。我鍾意睇唔同語言嘅小說，特別係科幻小說同奇幻小說嘅類型，因為我會沉浸喺遙遠嘅世界入面。羅馬尼亞文對我嚟講仍然係一個吸血鬼嘅好奇心，我冇探索過太多。另外，我對拉迪諾亦都好奇，又名猶太西班牙文。有趣嘅係，我識得點樣發音古典拉丁文。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Myself, I have been involved with essentially two Buddhist temples, the Wat Yanviriya, a Thai temple in East Vancouver, BC, and the International Buddhist Temple, a Chinese temple on Lulu Island, BC. The latter was on Steveston Highway. The former was Theravāda Buddhism, and the latter was Pure Land Buddhism, also known as Amidism. I started Buddhism with Zen, many years previously.

jyutping: ngo5 zi6 gei2，gei1 bun2 soeng6 caam1 jyu5 gwo3 loeng5 go3 fat6 gaau3 zi6 miu2，jat1 go3 hai6 hai2 bei1 si1 saang2 dung1 wan1 go1 waa4 ge3 taai3 gwok3 zi6 miu2「Yanviriya zi2」，tung4 maai4 hai2 bei1 si1 saang2 lou6 lou6 dou2 ge3 jat1 gaan3 zung1 gwok3 zi6 miu2「gwok3 zai3 fat6 zi2」。hau6 ze2 hai6 hai2 si2 tai4 fu1 si1 deon6 gung1 lou6 soeng6 min6。cin4 ze2 hai6 soeng6 zo6 bou6 fat6 gaau3，hau6 ze2 hai6 zing6 tou2 fat6 gaau3，jau6 cing1 aa3 mai5 dak1 gaau3。ngo5 hai6 jung6 sim4 zung1 lai4 hoi1 ci2 cyun4 joeng4 fat6 gaau3，hai6 hou2 do1 nin4 cin4。
text: 我自己，基本上參與過兩個佛教寺廟，一個係喺卑詩省東溫哥華嘅泰國寺廟「Yanviriya寺」，同埋喺卑詩省露露島嘅一間中國寺廟「國際佛寺」。後者係喺史提夫斯頓公路上面。前者係上座部佛教，後者係淨土佛教，又稱阿米德教。我係用禪宗嚟開始傳揚佛教，係好多年前。
